EC1: - Treatment with a first [OR] or second generation of EGFR-TKI within 7 days of study entry; previous treatment with a third generation of EGFR-TKI.
EC3: - Unstable spinal cord compression/ [OR] brain metastases.
EC4: - Severe/ [OR] uncontrolled systemic diseases, including uncontrolled hypertension, [OR] bleeding diatheses [OR] or infection.
EC5: - QTcF>470 msec during the screening period.
EC6: - Severe respiratory diseases such as interstitial lung disease, severe asthma, [OR] pulmonary embolism, etc.
EC7: - previous treatment with 2 or more lines of Chemotherapy [OR] or immunotherapy.
